description: This file defines the 'nusoap_server' class which implements a SOAP server as part of a web service framework. It includes methods for handling HTTP headers, parsing requests, invoking PHP functions or class methods via SOAP, serializing responses into SOAP envelopes, and managing WSDL definitions. The class facilitates creating, registering, and servicing SOAP-based web services within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: nusoap_server
classes.description: Main class implementing a SOAP server capable of handling requests, invoking functions or class methods, serializing responses, and managing WSDL definitions.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: Backward compatibility wrapper class extending nusoap_server.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Processes incoming SOAP requests or WSDL requests and generates appropriate responses.

methods.name: parse_http_headers
methods.description: Parses HTTP request headers to extract relevant SOAP headers, request method, and encoding.

methods.name: parse_request
methods.description: Parses the SOAP request payload and sets related fields, includes handling content encoding.

methods.name: invoke_method
methods.description: Invokes the PHP function or class method specified by the SOAP request, handling validation and parameters.

methods.name: serialize_return
methods.description: Serializes the return value into a SOAP envelope for response.

methods.name: send_response
methods.description: Dispatches the SOAP response or fault to the client with appropriate HTTP headers.

methods.name: verify_method
methods.description: Verifies if the requested SOAP operation exists and is valid.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses incoming SOAP message from the client into PHP data types.

methods.name: getHTTPBody
methods.description: Returns the HTTP body containing the SOAP message.

methods.name: getHTTPContentType
methods.description: Returns the Content-Type header for the response.

methods.name: getHTTPContentTypeCharset
methods.description: Returns the charset for the Content-Type header.

methods.name: add_to_map
methods.description: Deprecated method to add to operation map.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a PHP function or class method as a SOAP operation.

methods.name: configureWSDL
methods.description: Initializes a WSDL description for the service, enabling WSDL generation.
